poll.question: Dan shoulders his pack at the open ramp. Hui Ling holds the moment with him. Does she let him go alone, or does she go with him?

options.label: Let him go
options.desc: She stays with Mari. She trusts him. The ramp closes behind him.

options.label: Go with him
options.desc: Mari stays sealed in the van. Hui Ling moves into the dark at his side.

options.label: Keep the ramp open
options.desc: He goes alone. They keep it open—a lifeline burning through the night.

in_play.label: Close it
in_play.desc: Fear returns as dark falls; he seals the fortress.
